lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is narrowest at the shoulder and increases towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Posterior lines 10 and 11 terminate in the mid-flank area, failing to reach the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 7-9 distinct white spots clustered on the lower posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower haunch exhibit a diagonal linear alignment towards the posterior leg.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: A lyrate, spiral trajectory with an initial upward-outward vector followed by an inward-directed curve at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.0 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory terminal tips represent approximately 10-15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white chevron on the nasal bridge; two white spots on the cheek; elongated white-tipped dorsal crest.
